column1: # Used by can-routes-apply.sh to accept names in place of numbers, and by the
# configuration page to label PGNs. Any PGN may still be given as a decimal or
# 0x-hex number whether or not it appears here — this file is a convenience,
# never a whitelist of what is routable.
# Sourced from SAE J1939-71 / J1939-DA parameter group assignments. Entries
# marked (TP) are normally multi-packet: a frame-level filter cannot match them
# by PGN, because they travel as TP.CM/TP.DT frames whose identifiers carry the
# transport PGN (60416/60160), not the payload PGN. can-routes-apply.sh warns
# when one is used in a route.
# Keep sorted by PGN. Tab-separated; '#' begins a comment.
